name: tcgen05 5th-gen Tensor Core: native FP4/FP6 support and emulation paths
arithmetic_intensity: The tcgen05.mma instruction on Blackwell (sm_100a) supports multiple .kind values that determine which precision formats are natively executed. From the PTX ISA 9.4 Table 48: .kind::f16 supports FP16/BF16 at K=16 (dense) or K=32 (sparse); .kind::f8f6f4 supports FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) and FP6 (E2M3/E3M2) at K=32 (dense) or K=64/128 (sparse), with FP4 (E2M1) at K=64 (dense) or K=128 (sparse) - but only E4M3/E5m2 for K=64; .kind::mxf8f6f4 supports block-scaled FP8/FP6 with UE8M0 scale at K=32/64 (dense) or K=64/128 (sparse); .kind::mxf4 supports block-scaled FP4 (E2M1) with UE8M0 scale at K=64/96 (dense) or K=128/192 (sparse); .kind::mxf4nvf4 supports NVFP4 (E2M1) with UE8M0/UE4M3/UE5M3 scales at K=64/96 (dense) or K=128/192 (sparse). The key distinction: FP4 E2M1 is natively supported in .kind::f8f6f4 (non-block-scaled), .kind::mxf4 (block-scaled with UE8M0), and .kind::mxf4nvf4 (NVFP4 with UE4M3/UE5M3 scales). FP6 E2M3/E3M2 is natively supported in .kind::f8f6f4 and .kind::mxf8f6f4. However, K=96 for .kind::mxf4/.kind::mxf4nvf4 is only supported on sm_103a and sm_107a (not sm_100a), and K=128/192 for those kinds requires sm_107f or higher. On sm_100a (B200), the maximum K for block-scaled FP4 is 64 (dense) or 128 (sparse). CUTLASS 4.8 lists higher-throughput FP8 (MMA_K=64) and FP4 (MMA_K=128) Tensor Core MMA instructions for Blackwell. The emulation path: CUTLASS example 78_blackwell_emulated_bf16x9_gemm shows FP32 emulation via BF16 on Blackwell, and example 84_blackwell_narrow_precision_sparse_gemm shows block-scaled sparse GEMM.
scales_with: precision (FP16 -> FP8 -> FP6 -> FP4 changes MMA_K and throughput)
block scaling format (none vs UE8M0 vs UE4M3/UE5M3)
architecture target (sm_100a vs sm_103a vs sm_107a vs sm_107f)
CTA group size (1 or 2 for tcgen05)
workarounds: Use .kind::f8f6f4 for non-block-scaled FP8/FP6/FP4 on sm_100a
Use .kind::mxf4nvf4 for NVFP4 with UE4M3/UE5M3 scales (requires sm_100a or higher)
Use .kind::mxf4 for MXFP4 with UE8M0 power-of-two scales
For K=96 block-scaled FP4, target sm_103a or sm_107a (not sm_100a)
For K=128/192 block-scaled FP4, target sm_107f or higher
Use CUTLASS 4.8+ for Blackwell tcgen05 kernel support
notes:
The tcgen05.mma instruction is issued by a single thread (not a warpgroup like Hopper's wgmma), accumulates in Tensor Memory (TMEM) rather than registers, and can span 2 CTAs in a cluster. TMEM on sm_100a/sm_100f is 512 columns x 128 lanes per CTA with 32-bit cells. The largest single-CTA BF16/FP16 UMMA tile is 128x256x16 (~2x the largest Hopper WGMMA atom). 2-CTA MMA reaches 256x256x16. PTX ISA 9.4 adds UE5M3 as a scale type for tcgen05.mma and .kind::ti16 qualifier. CUTLASS README explicitly warns: sm100a-compiled kernels are NOT compatible with RTX 50 series (SM120) because SM120 has a different compute capability from datacenter SM100.
